payload.name: Honest Unmeasured Wire Telemetry
payload.description: Record only authentic wire-observed timing, token, and cache metrics from live flows and captured transactions.jsonl logs, representing unavailable or unmeasured fields explicitly as None with diagnostic reasons (such as FlowTiming.decode_reason() returning 'non-streaming', 'no chunk window', or floor-threshold explanations in src/holon_coherence/proxy/timing.py). CumulativeMetrics (src/holon_coherence/proxy/metrics.py) and OfflineMetricsAccumulator (src/holon_coherence/metrics/aggregation.py) accumulate only positive measured samples so unmeasured turns never bias averages or A/B evaluations in src/holon_coherence/ab_testing/evaluation.py.
payload.action: Never fabricate synthetic estimates, mock stream generators, or zero/placeholder defaults for unmeasured wire telemetry; return None from timing and usage resolvers when a measurement is absent or below validity floors, guard accumulator increments on positive measured values, and derive all benchmarks exclusively from authentic wire logs or live runs.
